items.title: Spot the cleartext services
items.instructions: Review the scan, then answer both parts.

evidence.title: $ nmap -sV 10.0.0.5
evidence.text:
PORT    STATE SERVICE VERSION
21/tcp  open  ftp     vsftpd 3.0.3
22/tcp  open  ssh     OpenSSH 8.9
23/tcp  open  telnet  Linux telnetd
443/tcp open  https   nginx 1.24

parts.title: Part 1
parts.prompt: Select the TWO cleartext services to disable.

parts.title: Part 2
parts.prompt: Build the command that produced this output.

items.explanation: FTP and Telnet are cleartext. The VERSION column means -sV was used against the single host 10.0.0.5.
